text:
Priya (PM): Quick sync — ACME signed an LOI and wants private VPC onramp in their EU region, target 'customer-ready' by 2026-06-15. They're asking for dedicated GPUs + SSO + audit logs. Can we hit that date? :eyes:
Alex (Eng): Who's owning what pieces? My team can do API/workflow changes but need infra + security signoff early.
Jordan (Runtime): On runtime side, model variants and quantization profiles for private deploy will take ~3 weeks to validate if we have reserved capacity. Also need to confirm sequence length and KV cache expectations from ACME.
Sam (Infra): Reservation note — EU GPU pool capacity is limited; we can reserve 2x A100 equivalent now but lead time for physical capacity + network peering is ~4 weeks. We'll need purchase/order approvals.
Lena (Security): Security checklist: SSO (OIDC integration), customer-specific KMS keys, infra network isolation review, and final penetration test. PT window is ~2 weeks plus remediation. SOC2 artifacts mostly ok.
Carlos (Solutions): I've been on the calls. ACME expects full VPC peering + SIEM integration and an incident notification SLO. They indicated they'd accept a canary for one workspace first.
Priya (PM): Proposal: split into two-phase delivery — Phase 1: canary private instance for 1 workspace (minimal SLA) by 2026-06-15; Phase 2: full fleet + SIEM + KMS by 2026-07-31. Thoughts?
Alex (Eng): Phase 1 seems reasonable if runtime can supply a hardened model bundle and infra can guarantee isolated subnet + NAT. We'll need a short auth flow change for tenant bootstrapping. Estimate: 2 engineers x 3 weeks.
Jordan (Runtime): Agree. To be explicit, Phase 1 constraints: serve a quantized 8-bit model variant, disabled long-context features, KV cache disabled initially. That reduces validation time.
Sam (Infra): I can start capacity reservation for two nodes today, but procurement lead time forces us to mark July 1 as optimistic for full scale. For the canary we can use burst capacity (no SLA).
Lena (Security): Can we front-load the SSO and KMS review? If ACME can provide their IdP metadata and KMS details this week, we can start the assessment in parallel. Pen test request needs separate sign-off.
Carlos (Solutions): I'll ask ACME for IdP metadata and KMS info today. Also pushing them to accept canary limitations: no KV caching, lower throughput SLA.
Priya (PM): OK action items so far:
- Carlos: collect IdP + KMS + SIEM details from ACME by EOD tomorrow.
- Sam: start a provisional EU capacity reservation and share cost delta.
- Jordan: prepare a Phase 1 runtime bundle (quantized, KV disabled) and minimal test harness.
- Alex: draft tenant bootstrap change and estimate dev allocation.
- Lena: begin security intake once Carlos has IdP/KMS docs.
(We'll use deploy-bot for canary rollout once infra is ready)
deploy-bot: queued canary cluster reservation request #CNR-482 — awaiting infra approval.
Alex (Eng): Small note on rollback: Phase 1 must include automatic fallback to hosted model if private endpoint has errors. We should add a routing policy in config.
Jordan (Runtime): Good call — I'll add a routing policy that falls back to hosted low-latency model and records mismatches.
Sam (Infra): I'll update the reservation with a 'canary-only' flag and list expected IP ranges for peering.
Lena (Security): If we can get IdP + KMS by tomorrow, security intake complete by 2026-05-15 (assuming no major findings). PT window tentatively scheduled 2026-06-20.
Priya (PM): Can everyone react with :+1: if they agree to the plan or :thinking_face: if blocked. We'll reconvene Tue 9am PT for a quick gating check.
Alex (Eng): :+1:
Jordan (Runtime): :+1:
Sam (Infra): :+1:
Lena (Security): :thinking_face: (depends on IdP docs)
Carlos (Solutions): :+1: (sending docs today)
Priya (PM): Thanks — I'll create a short launch checklist and attach to the ticket. Quick checklist draft:
```
- Customer IdP metadata received
- KMS key ARN confirmed
- EU canary capacity reserved
- Runtime bundle v1 validated (quantized)
- Tenant bootstrap endpoint implemented + verified
- Security intake complete
- Canary smoke tests passing
- Routing fallback configured
```
Priya (PM): I'll paste this into the ticket and tag owners. If any major blockers pop up, shout in this thread.
Carlos (Solutions): ACME replied: IdP metadata + KMS ARN sent to my email. I'll drop into the ticket now.
Lena (Security): Received the artifacts, starting intake.
Sam (Infra): Reservation made (provisional). Cost delta + procurement tickets attached.
Jordan (Runtime): Runtime bundle build kicked off. ETA 10 business days for validation.
Alex (Eng): I'll carve out 2 engineers next sprint.
Priya (PM): Great — reconvene Tue 9am. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
